description: This Java class 'ApacheFopWorker' provides utilities for transforming XSL-FO files into various output formats like PDF using Apache FOP. It manages FOP factory instances, configuration, temporary file creation, and transformation methods, and appears to be a specialized utility component within the OFBiz framework for PDF generating tasks.

classes.name: ApacheFopWorker
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for transforming XSL-FO documents into PDF or other formats via Apache FOP, managing configuration, temporary files, and transformation processes.

methods.name: getFactoryInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of FopFactory, initializing it with configuration files if not already instantiated.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Overloaded methods to transform XSL-FO files or streams into output formats such as PDF using Apache FOP.

methods.name: createFopInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a Fop object for processing, optionally with user-defined FOUserAgent.

methods.name: createTempFoXmlFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary XML file for FO content, which must be deleted after use.

methods.name: createTempResultFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary file to hold FOP transform results, which must be deleted after use.

methods.name: getEncryptionLengthDefault
methods.description: Returns the default encryption length setting for PDFs.

methods.name: getUserPasswordDefault
methods.description: Returns the default user password for encrypted PDFs.

methods.name: getOwnerPasswordDefault
methods.description: Returns the default owner password for encrypted PDFs.

methods.name: getAllowPrintDefault
methods.description: Returns the default setting for allowing print permission in PDFs.

methods.name: getAllowCopyContentDefault
methods.description: Returns the default setting for allowing copying content in PDFs.

methods.name: getAllowEditContentDefault
methods.description: Returns the default setting for allowing content editing in PDFs.

methods.name: getAllowEditAnnotationsDefault
methods.description: Returns the default setting for allowing annotation editing in PDFs.

methods.name: getAllowAccessContentDefault
methods.description: Returns the default setting for allowing access to content.

methods.name: getAllowFillInFormsDefault
methods.description: Returns the default setting for allowing form filling.

methods.name: getAllowAssembleDocumentDefault
methods.description: Returns the default setting for allowing document assembly.

methods.name: getAllowPrintHqDefault
methods.description: Returns the default setting for allowing high-quality printing.

methods.name: getEncryptMetadataDefault
methods.description: Returns the default setting for encrypting PDF metadata.
